inclusions: Accommodation for 2 nights in selected category hotels.
Private vehicle for all transfers and sightseeing as per the itinerary.

days.title: Day 1 – Arrival in Varanasi
activities: Meet and greet with our representative.
Check in to the hotel and freshen up.
Proceed for darshan at Kashi Vishwanath Temple.
Explore the ancient lanes of Varanasi with a local companion/guide.
In the evening, proceed towards Dashashwamedh Ghat.
Witness the famous and spiritual Ganga Aarti.

days.title: Day 2 – Varanasi Sightseeing
activities: Visit Sarnath Museum, subject to operational timings.
Visit Wat Thai Temple and the 80-feet Buddha Statue.
Later, proceed for Varanasi local sightseeing.
Visit Vyas Kashi / Ram Nagar Fort.
Visit the New Kashi Vishwanath Temple located inside the Banaras Hindu University campus.
Visit Durga Mandir near Durga Kund.

days.title: Day 3 - Varanasi Departure
activities: Transfer to Varanasi Airport/Railway Station as per the departure schedule.
Depart for your onward journey with divine memories of Kashi.
